usage: Common noun for an earring; usually used in the singular as a general item name, even when talking about a pair.
Often appears in everyday shopping, fashion, and getting-ready contexts, e.g. choosing, buying, wearing, or taking off earrings.
Can be modified with material, style, or colour words, such as gold, silver, pearl, or small/big types.
Natural in spoken Cantonese and written Chinese; if you want to say a pair, add 㩒對 / 一對 before it.
